headline: Belgium will cancel most of its flights on Monday, November 23, due to a national strike
summary: Air traffic controller Skeyes will suspend regular services for 14 hours during a national strike, as the De Wever government seeks to save €10 billion to cut the fiscal deficit.
why: Belgium's budget consolidation and labor disputes affect the country's fiscal outlook and government bond investors, while strikes disrupt airline operations.
original_headline: Bélgica cancelará la mayoría de sus vuelos el lunes 23 de noviembre por huelga nacional
